body.objective: If one complex compensator with separated scale and compact-phase connections still fails, test the smallest additional-field mechanism: a two-field charge matrix that can separate the anomaly compensator, scale-setting radial direction and physical relational phase.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal separated scale/U1 preflight and its conditional full-gate disposition.  If the one-field theory passes the full gate, close this alternative as NOT_ACTIVATED.  Otherwise declare two complex or real-plus-complex compensator representations with a general integer compact-U1 charge matrix and real scale weights, quotient equivalent bases by GL(Z) and field redefinitions, and classify the minimal faithful rank cases.  For the lowest two-derivative parity-even action ansatz derive Ward identities, gauge/reducibility rank, stationary cylinder and Berger equations, dressed-trace disposition, scalar kinetic/principal forms and raw-D/phase charges.  Use exact Smith/Hermite normal forms for charge lattices and exact elimination for couplings.  Either exhibit the first nonempty healthy representation/coupling locus or prove the incompatibility within the declared minimal ansatz.  Stop before a full BV carrier unless a genuine locus survives.
body.current_gate: minimal two-compensator charge-lattice and health preflight
body.forbid: no arbitrary real compact charges; no duplicate charge bases counted as distinct theories; no sampled scan; no extra field called a new gauge generator without the action Ward identity; no higher derivatives or unrestricted potential fitted to force stationarity; no causal or quantum claim from the preflight
activates: full action-derived BV/causal completion only for a certified passing charge stratum
body.resource_hint: FAIL-FAST REPRESENTATION PREFLIGHT.  Canonicalize the charge lattice before solving background equations; use Forge SNF/polyhedral kernels as independent rails.
notes: This does not test general multifield scalar-tensor theory.  It isolates the smallest representation change capable of separating three roles that one field may be unable to carry.
